# Thomas Bade Knowledge Graph & GEO Platform

Canonical URL: https://www.thomas-bade.de/knowledge-graph/
Language: de-DE
Author: Thomas Bade

## Machine-readable resources

- Page inventory: https://www.thomas-bade.de/knowledge-graph/data/pages.json
- Knowledge graph: https://www.thomas-bade.de/knowledge-graph/data/graph.json
- Per-page JSON and Markdown: https://www.thomas-bade.de/knowledge-graph/data/exports/
- Per-page Schema.org JSON-LD: https://www.thomas-bade.de/knowledge-graph/data/jsonld/

The scores are transparent heuristic maturity indicators. They are not ranking guarantees or guarantees of inclusion in AI Overviews.
